newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 10.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 10.

text.p: Here are the main headlines from Lithuania's M-1 plus radio station's noon news report on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Students rallied in front of the government centre to protest its decision to use the newly built Congress House for state purposes. The building had been slated to become an institute for international relations and political science.

- Police detained a woman, "Nina P", of Shvenchioneliai whom they say conned people out of money by promising them jobs at the Ignalina Nuclear Power Plant. Police are investigating how the woman could have pulled off the scheme on the premises of the plant.
